recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見卵圓至略長形核、染色質呈細顆粒狀、偶見明顯核仁的細胞，細胞質豐富淡染透亮並含稀疏的深色嗜鹼性顆粒，其間混有具紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球，符合非典型肥大細胞。
features: Medium to large cells with round-oval to elongated nuclei and finely granular chromatin
Abundant pale to clear cytoplasm containing sparse, coarse dark basophilic granules
Admixed eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and bright eosinophilic granules
Background of residual marrow cells, red cells and a thin fibrous septum
describe_en: Oil-immersion H&E shows an infiltrate of medium to large cells with oval to elongated nuclei, finely granular chromatin and occasional single prominent nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant, pale to clear, and contains sparse coarse basophilic granules. Eosinophils are admixed, and a thin fibrous septum traverses the field. Findings are consistent with atypical mast cells of systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 confirm lineage and aberrant phenotype.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have round to bean-shaped nuclei with a clear halo but no cytoplasmic basophilic granules, and are CD20+/annexin A1+.
Monocytes/histiocytes have folded nuclei and fine cytoplasm without metachromatic granules and are tryptase-negative.
Basophils are smaller with segmented nuclei and dense granules obscuring the nucleus, and are tryptase-low and CD117-negative.
Mast cell leukemia requires >=20% mast cells on the aspirate smear, which cannot be assessed on a biopsy section alone.
